symptom: A stale or reconnecting browser clears a server job failure or active status, and an unacknowledged cancel hides active GPU work
direct_cause: Desktop snapshot convergence and optimistic cancellation assume browser-owned polling; terminal merge only protected unseen success
class_root: Server jobs own execution fields for every outcome, while browsers own candidate choice and authored edits
affected_population: Batch generation of an already placed shot
Previously trimmed clips and multiple uses of a shot
internal_only_reason: This is the Nomi internal split between candidate ownership and authored timeline state; provider documentation cannot decide it
invariants: A stale browser cannot overwrite server pending or terminal run fields
Reconnecting views read current server job snapshots
Cancellation changes state only after an owned, targeted provider acknowledgement

door_reduction.why_not: Server writer, hydration and acknowledged cancellation are distinct host entry points for one ownership rule

generality_proof: The server merges execution fields at one serialized project writer; browser reconnect projection uses job identity and does not touch the timeline

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Protect server run state while preserving editorial changes

same_class_entry_points.evidence: All web saves pass through the serialized merger
Every active web view reads server job snapshots

recurrence.reason: All web tabs and every stale persistence cycle can repeat the ownership error
same_class_scan: Read actual runtime TaskResult envelope and renderer taskApi

prevention.invariant: Server job outcomes survive stale views
prevention.strategy: Central server merge and explicit reconnect projection

legacy_paths.rationale: New web transport keeps the existing runtime contract; there is no alternate legacy collector

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The application owns source windows and generation completion policy

migration: Existing desktop convergence and cancellation are retained; new web nodes carry the server ownership marker
residual_risks: GPU pending reconnect and cancellation require live browser verification

invariant_owner_layer.why: Server-owned execution fields are protected at the shared save boundary
